summary: Tested iteration-18 VIP calendar features — availability bulk/weekly, slot payload (rates+extra_hour_price), cancelled/declined filtering, mid-date extend (vip_sched + date_bookings), reminders. Backend pytest: 10/10 pass. Frontend Playwright: VipBookings loads under /vip-bookings as VIP user; VipAvailabilityEditor renders with all required test-ids (vip-schedule-manager, vs-avail-tab-days/weekly, vip-schedule-calendar, vs-avail-ranges-add/from-0/to-0, vs-avail-add, vs-avail-weeks, vs-avail-add-weekly, weekly-toggle-{0..6}). weekly-copy-all-{d} only mounts once the weekday is toggled on (expected). Language switcher works — Español translates tabs (Solicitudes/Confirmadas/Pasadas/Disponibilidad/Mis solicitudes), intro, booking card time range 'Inicio HH:MM → Fin HH:MM', buttons (Confirmar/Rechazar).

minor.issue: Does not invoke _vs_tick — only _run_lifecycle and _run_booking_reminders. VIP schedule reminders (reminder_24_sent / reminder_1h_sent) are driven exclusively by the internal _vs_reminder_loop background task (every 60s). Request suggested calling /cron/tick to verify VIP reminders; that will not fire them. Reminders are nevertheless produced in-process (verified via direct _vs_tick() call in test).

issues: Subheading 'VIP Dates' above the DateBookingList is hardcoded English — not translated when switching to ES/RU/etc. All other labels on the page translate correctly.

action_items: Optional: wire _vs_tick into /api/cron/tick (next to _run_lifecycle / _run_booking_reminders) so an external cron can drive VIP-schedule reminders; today it depends on the in-process asyncio loop surviving restarts.
Minor: translate the 'VIP Dates' subheading on /vip-bookings (currently hardcoded).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5497 lines — still should be split (vip_schedule.py, vip_profile.py, bookings.py).
_vs_reminder_loop is only started via @app.on_event('startup'); FastAPI deprecates on_event — migrate to lifespan handler to avoid future breakage.
VipBookExtend reuses the generic '_charge_extension' which assumes the target has a VIP profile; for date_bookings extend to a non-VIP target this still charges 250/h (default) — document or guard.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file for iteration-18: /app/backend/tests/test_vip_schedule_v18.py (10 tests, 3.9s). It touches vip_avail, vip_sched, date_bookings, notifications, and the user's prices. The test_extend_in_progress case pre-cleans any today-dated date_bookings for the VIP to avoid SLOT_TAKEN noise from co-tests. _vs_tick is imported and called directly in-process to deterministically verify the 1h reminder; the cron /api/cron/tick endpoint does NOT run it.
rca of the issue: N/A — all tested flows green. One missing i18n key ('VIP Dates') and one wiring gap (/cron/tick ≠ _vs_tick) reported as non-blocking.
